I was going through my old images and found this GPT 4o prompt and now comparing it to GPT Image 5.2

The first image is better but shows how great GPT 4o image generation was for its time. 

Monochrome surreal illustration in the style of high-contrast graphite/airbrush engraving, square format. A royal **queen** (left) and **king** (right) face each other in a long one-point-perspective corridor. • Floor: glossy black-and-white **checkerboard** receding to a bright vanishing point. • Walls/ceiling: dense Escher-like **interlocking rectangular beams** forming a zigzag tunnel; impossible geometry; heavy relief; repeating chevrons toward the center. • Queen: flowing layered gown with deep folds and ruffles, ornate crown, wavy hair; arm extended as if greeting. • King: bearded, ermine-trimmed robe with spotted mantle, tall jeweled crown; arm extended to reply. Symmetrical composition, camera at eye level; strong rim lights and soft bounce; sharp cast shadows on the tiles; no color (pure grayscale); razor-clean edges and micro-shading for sculpted depth; reflective floor glints near the figures. NEGATIVE: color, text, extra people, modern objects, soft cartoons, blur, textures of paper grain.

prompts.text:
A fun way to visualize weddings in different cultures. 

2x2 grid, 16:9, do this for 4 cultures, 4 very different eras <instructions>

Role: Wedding Culture Anthropologist & Miniature Ceremony Designer
Input: [Country or Culture] + optional [Region / Era / Religious or Secular Context]
Phase 1: Ceremony Logic

Analyze wedding culture through:

Courtship and engagement

Clothing
Processions
Ceremony spaces
Music
Symbolic objects
Family roles
Gift exchange
Post-ceremony rituals
Regional variation
Select 4 distinct wedding micro-traditions using gates:

One preparation ritual

One ceremony ritual
One family/community ritual
One unusual regional, historic, disappearing, or post-ceremony tradition
Ensure the four panels depict different phases of the wedding rather than four similar ceremonies
Derive for each:

Ritual Action

Symbolic Object
Participants
Architecture
Textile/Material
Sound/Motion Cue
Color Palette
Time of Day
Phase 2: Visual Execution

Goal: 2x2 Grid of “Wedding Invitations and Keepsake Boxes as Miniature Ceremony Stages.”

Rules per Panel

Dynamic Container: Select an appropriate wedding-related object:
invitation box
ring box
textile pouch
ceremonial envelope
gift chest
folded program

Paper/Textile Engineering Rule:
Invitation folds → walls and ceremonial screens
Ribbon → processional path
Wax seal → central platform
Ring cushion → raised stage
Embroidery → floor pattern
Character Rule: Include 3–7 tiny figures depending on ritual scale.
Action Rule: Depict the derived ritual at the exact moment its meaning is visually clearest.
Cultural Specificity Rule: Clothing, gestures, architecture and symbolic objects must be regionally grounded; avoid generic “wedding” styling.
Detail Rule: Add exactly 5 meaningful ceremonial objects.
Text Restriction: Only a small identification plaque; invitation body text should remain abstract/unreadable.
Label: [Ritual | Region/Culture | Country | Era].
Camera & Look
Photoreal miniature ceremonial photography, 45mm lens across all panels, soft directional studio light combined with realistic diegetic lamps/candles where appropriate, shallow DOF, slate-gray seamless background, exceptional paper, textile, jewelry, wood and floral detail, no watermark.
</instructions>

提示词：
9:16 竖版，高精度风格化 3D CG 东方幻想女性角色海报，semi-realistic anime-style 3D character render，high-end oriental fantasy flower spirit character design，premium cinematic CG portrait。
画面主体是一位明确成年的东方幻想女性，视觉年龄约 24–27 岁，身份如同月华花海中诞生的高贵花灵 / 灵姬。整体气质梦幻、优雅、轻盈、神秘、华美，带有安静而迷人的高级幻想感。整体不是普通二次元插画，也不是人偶或手办，而是具有生命感的高精度风格化 3D CG 东方幻想角色原型。
人物拥有精致柔美的东方动漫化五官，小巧流畅的鹅蛋脸，肤色冷白通透，皮肤细腻柔和，带高级次表面散射。眼睛清澈明亮，眼尾略微拉长，睫毛纤长，眼神柔和含笑，神态从容轻盈。鼻梁秀气挺直，嘴唇小巧柔润，唇色为淡粉冷调。五官精致但不过度网红化，保持高级、通透、空灵的东方幻想美感。
人物拥有大量冰蓝色、月光蓝与银雾蓝交织的超长发，发型为双侧云团髻 / 双侧盘发结构，发间带精致的银饰、花形发扣与细小宝石装饰。长发如水流、月光与丝带般大面积铺展在身体四周，发丝层层卷曲、轻盈飘散，形成华丽而柔美的流动曲线。头发边缘具有柔和的透光感与细腻高光。
服装为高精度 3D CG 东方幻想花灵礼装，整体以月白色、冰蓝色和极浅雾蓝色为主。上身为修身塑形的东方幻想礼服结构，融合轻微立领、东方纹饰拼接与精致收腰设计，肩部与手臂搭配半透明轻纱袖套，胸前、腰间和裙身点缀银色金属扣件、花枝纹装饰、宝石镶嵌与细链流苏。下身为层层叠叠的大面积薄纱与褶皱裙摆，质感轻盈、通透、梦幻，形成如花瓣般绽放的体积感。整体服装材质为丝绸、雪纺、欧根纱、薄纱与少量晶体饰件，具有高级柔光反射。
人物躺卧在一片由巨大月白玫瑰、冰蓝花瓣和发光花海构成的梦幻祭坛之中，花朵层层堆叠，形成柔软而华美的背景与承托结构。玫瑰并非普通写实花束，而是带有东方幻想神域气息的巨大灵花，花心隐约散发冷白月光。花海之间弥漫轻薄雾气与柔和辉光，形成静谧、圣洁、梦境般的空间氛围。
人物采用全身斜躺构图，镜头从上方偏左俯视。头部位于画面左上区域，腿部优雅地向画面右下延伸，身体整体形成流畅的 S 型曲线。她一只手轻抬，举起一把华丽的东方幻想灵钥 / 星月法器，法器采用银黑金属与冰蓝发光晶石结构，造型精致镂空，融合羽翼、花瓣、新月与古老神纹元素，具有神秘仪式感。另一只手自然放松，姿态轻盈，整体动作优雅稳定。
人物头发、裙摆、花瓣与薄纱共同形成环绕式流动构图，大量曲线向四周铺展，营造出梦幻、沉浸、包裹式的视觉效果。
光影采用电影级梦幻柔光设计：主要光源来自画面上方与花海内部的冷白月光，照亮人物脸部、肩颈、胸前、手臂和腿部；四周花海与薄纱形成柔和反射光，使阴影区域保持清晰层次；头发边缘、肩线、手臂和腿部轮廓带有细腻的银蓝轮廓光。整体高光柔和扩散，带轻微 bloom 和 halation，光效梦幻但不失清晰度。
色彩采用统一的冷色高级幻想体系：冰蓝、月白、雾蓝、浅紫蓝为主色，少量银色与极少量淡金用于饰品点缀。整体色调纯净、通透、华美，不发灰、不发脏，不出现明显暖橙色和高饱和杂色。人物肌肤始终保持冷白、柔亮、干净。
空气中可漂浮少量微小发光粒子、花瓣碎片、灵气光点与细小悬浮装饰，数量克制，增强梦境氛围而不显廉价。画面整体呈现高级、唯美、沉浸式的东方幻想 3D CG 角色海报质感。

prompts.text:
1、GPT Image 2图片提示词，可以用一张你喜欢的人物头像作为参考。

参考上传的人物头像，生成一张9:16竖屏、超写实高定礼服时尚拼贴图，用于Seedance 2.0卡点换装视频首帧。头像作为严格的人物身份与五官参考。

主体为同一位明确成年的中国年轻女性，视觉年龄约25岁。五个版本必须严格保持同一张脸、同一年龄感、同一肤色、同一发型、同一耳饰和同一身材比例。

严格继承参考头像的五官特征：柔和鹅蛋脸，流畅细致的下颌线；深棕色杏仁眼，眼尾轻微上扬，自然平行双眼皮；自然纤细眉形；鼻梁纤细顺直，鼻尖小巧圆润；嘴唇自然饱满，裸粉色水光唇；暖调白皙肤色，鼻梁和双颊保留清晰但自然的浅雀斑；黑茶色松散盘发，发根蓬松，额前及脸颊两侧保留自然碎发。佩戴相同的钻石流苏耳坠。五个人物不得发生换脸、五官漂移或雀斑消失。

画面中正好五个人物，全部是同一角色。

中央为最大型全身人物，占画面宽度约60%，正在高级时装秀台上向前迈步，一脚在前，双臂自然垂落，姿态优雅自信。中央人物穿珍珠象牙白高定鱼尾礼服：立体方形领口，建筑感胸衣结构，弧形公主线和精细内支撑，胸衣表面具有柔和立体弧度，上身轮廓饱满自然，腰线明显收窄，形成优雅胸腰比例；礼服使用珍珠白丝绸缎面，搭配精致珍珠刺绣和枝叶形珠饰，贴合腰臀，鱼尾裙摆向下自然展开，带有受控的小型拖尾。服装稳定覆盖、不透明、合体但不过度紧绷。

左上为较小的完整全身人物贴纸，穿宝石红丝绒高定礼服：优雅V形领口，立体裹身胸衣，交叠丝绒褶皱，胸衣轮廓自然饱满，腰部明显收紧，腰侧放射状水晶珠饰，修身直筒长裙，侧面开衩，裙摆和鞋子完整可见。

右上为较小的完整全身人物贴纸，穿宝石蓝高定鱼尾礼服：圆弧形领口，立体修身胸衣，深蓝水晶刺绣从上身中心向腰部放射，胸衣结构清晰，腰线纤细，裙身贴合腰臀，鱼尾裙摆完整展开，面料呈现真实丝绒与缎面光泽。

左下为较小的完整全身人物贴纸，穿黑曜石黑色高定礼服：不对称单肩领口，建筑感立体胸衣，单侧肩部形成雕塑式折叠结构，腰部收紧，腰侧具有黑色珠饰和放射状褶裥，修身长裙自然垂落，整体冷艳高级。

右下为较小的完整全身人物贴纸，穿祖母绿高定鱼尾礼服：立体方形领口，结构化胸衣，曲线形拼接线条，胸腰比例明确；一侧肩部与腰部装饰深绿色立体丝绸花朵和珠饰，裙身贴合腰臀，鱼尾裙摆和小型拖尾完整可见。

四个侧边小人物必须明显小于中央人物，分别位于左上、右上、左下、右下。每个小人物都是沿真实身体和完整礼服轮廓精确裁切的人物贴纸，各自带独立的白色手绘虚线描边。白色虚线必须贴合头发、肩部、手臂、腰部、裙摆和鞋子的完整轮廓。中央人物不加虚线描边。

五个人物采用相近、可兼容的全身站姿和步行姿势，头、肩、腰、手臂及双腿结构清楚，方便后续贴纸飞入中央并完成重合换装。所有人物完整露出头顶、双手、礼服下摆和鞋子，不得裁切。

背景为极简奢华高级时装秀影棚，深炭灰至暖香槟色渐变背景，深色抛光秀台地面，具有非常轻微的灯光反射。无观众、无杂物、无品牌标识。使用柔和电影主光、暖色轮廓光和高级时装商业摄影光线，真实呈现皮肤纹理、浅雀斑、发丝、丝绸、丝绒、水晶、珠饰、立体花饰、褶裥与礼服缝线。

整体色彩为珍珠象牙白、宝石红、宝石蓝、黑曜石黑和祖母绿，画面奢华、精致、冷艳、高级，具有国际高定时装广告质感。

硬性要求：正好五个人物，五人必须是同一个成年女性；人物五官、雀斑、发型和身材必须完全一致；中央人物最大；四个侧边人物为完整轮廓贴纸；禁止第六个人物；禁止矩形缩略图；无文字、无字幕、无Logo、无品牌、无水印。

2、视频拍摄脚本

参考图片@图片1 生成一段8秒、9:16、超写实奢华高定走秀卡点换装视频。

严格保持参考图中同一位中国成年女性的身份与五官：始终是同一张柔和鹅蛋脸、同一下颌线、深棕色微扬杏仁眼、自然平直眉、纤细顺直鼻梁、小巧圆润鼻尖、饱满裸粉色嘴唇、鼻梁和双颊的浅雀斑、暖调白皙真实肤质、黑茶色松散盘发、两侧自然碎发和钻石耳坠。不得换脸，不得改变年龄、五官比例、雀斑位置、发型、肤色和身材比例。

中央人物是唯一持续活动的真人模特。她始终在高级时装秀台上自信地向镜头走来，保持连续、自然、优雅的交叉台步。摄影机使用稳定的正面全身跟拍并以相同速度平稳后退，使人物在画面中的大小和中央位置基本不变；不摇晃、不旋转、不突然变焦。四个侧边小人物是固定在画面位置上的完整人物轮廓贴纸。

每次鼠标指针点击目标贴纸后，原位置贴纸在飞入启动的同一帧立即消失并永久留白；复制出的完整人物贴纸带着贴合全身和礼服轮廓的白色虚线，迅速放大并飞向中央。飞入过程中，贴纸姿态自然调整为中央人物当前的走路步态；与中央人物的头、肩、腰、双腿和当前步伐完全对齐后，在鞋跟落地的音乐重拍瞬间完成换装。飞入副本和白色虚线同时彻底消失，中央始终只保留一个真人，不产生双影。换装前后人物不停步、不重置姿势，步幅、重心、手臂摆动、视线和头发运动连续。

[0.00s–1.25s]

中央人物穿珍珠象牙白方领高定鱼尾礼服向前走秀。礼服具有立体结构上身、明确腰线、珍珠刺绣和受控拖尾。人物左脚向前，目光看向镜头；1.05秒指针点击左上红色贴纸，原贴纸立即消失，完整红色人物贴纸沿右下方向飞入。1.25秒左脚鞋跟落地并准确重合，换成宝石红丝绒V领高定礼服。人物保持相同步幅继续前行。

[1.25s–2.95s]

人物穿红色丝绒礼服继续走秀，腰部垂褶和裙摆随台步自然摆动。她的右脚向前，眼神短暂看向右上蓝色贴纸；2.70秒指针点击贴纸，右上原贴纸立即消失，蓝色完整人物贴纸沿左下方向飞入。2.95秒右脚鞋跟落下，换成宝石蓝水晶刺绣鱼尾礼服。换装前后右脚承重和手臂摆动完全连续。

[2.95s–4.40s]

人物穿蓝色礼服继续向前，水晶刺绣在灯光下产生克制闪光。左脚向前时，视线转向左下黑色贴纸；4.15秒指针点击，左下原贴纸立即消失，黑色完整人物贴纸沿右上方向飞入。4.40秒左脚鞋跟落地，换成黑色不对称肩线高定礼服。裙摆运动和头发碎发的惯性不中断。

[4.40s–6.55s]

人物穿黑色礼服继续走秀，保持肩背舒展、下巴微抬。右脚向前，视线转向右下绿色贴纸；6.25秒指针点击，右下原贴纸立即消失，绿色完整人物贴纸沿左上方向飞入。6.55秒右脚鞋跟落地，在全段最强音乐重拍中换成祖母绿方领立体花饰高定鱼尾礼服。

[6.55s–8.00s]

四张侧边贴纸已经全部消失，四个原位置保持干净留白，画面只剩中央人物。人物穿祖母绿礼服继续向前完成两步，立体花饰、鱼尾裙摆和拖尾具有真实重量与轻微惯性。7.45秒走到最终展示点，左脚停稳，身体轻微转向45度，一手自然落在腰侧，抬眼直视镜头，保持自信冷艳表情并定格至结束。

中央人物穿初始主造型：酒红色短斗篷，黑色天鹅绒领口，象牙白高领褶边衬衫，黑色高腰百褶裙，深棕色细腰带，腰带中央固定旧金色魔法学院徽章，黑色及膝长靴。面料具有真实的羊毛、天鹅绒、棉质衬衫和皮革质感。

左上放置造型1完整小人物：奶油白短款学院外套、酒红细领结、浅灰衬衫、炭黑百褶裙、棕黑短靴、腰侧小型魔法书袋。姿态与中央人物拓扑接近，右手轻抬，身体朝向中央。

右上放置造型2完整小人物：黑色修身夜巡长外套、酒红内衬、短款半斗篷、双层调查腰带、旧金扣件、黑色长靴。人物微侧身，双臂结构完整，目光指向中央人物。

左侧中部放置造型3完整小人物：酒红与黑色拼接的不对称战斗短外套、结构化肩部、象牙白内搭、黑色不对称及膝裙、深棕护腕、带扣长靴。姿态利落但不扭曲，右臂沿身体斜向伸展。

左下放置造型4完整小人物：酒红丝绒学院庆典中长礼服、象牙白小立领、旧金星轨刺绣、短斗篷式肩饰、黑色腰封和酒红低跟长靴。裙摆完整展开，不被画面边缘裁断。

四个小人物明显小于中央人物，全部是沿真实人体轮廓裁切的完整人物抠像，每个小人物外沿都有独立的白色手绘虚线贴纸描边。虚线必须贴合头发、肩膀、双臂、腰线、裙摆和腿部真实轮廓。中央人物不加虚线。小人物不是矩形照片、不是卡片缩略图。

右下区域保留适度呼吸留白。背景为浅灰白无缝影棚，加入非常克制的半透明酒红几何魔法阵线条与旧金星芒装饰，但不出现任何可读文字、字母、品牌、Logo或水印。

使用柔和漫射棚拍主光，配合轻微暖金轮廓光。眼睛具有自然高光，皮肤真实细腻但不过度磨皮，保留自然毛孔与轻微皮肤起伏。短发层次清楚，刘海和发梢具有真实发丝细节。所有衣料符合真实重力，斗篷、裙摆、皮革腰带和金属徽章材质清晰。

整体呈现酒红、象牙白、黑色和旧金色构成的甜酷魔法学院视觉，超写实真人Coser摄影，不是二维动漫插画。

硬性限制：画面正好5个人物；5人必须是同一位成年女性；中央人物最大；四个小人物明显更小；右下留白；不出现第六人物；不改变参考人物的脸、发型或发色；不使用矩形缩略图；不裁掉人物头部；不出现错误肢体、多余手指、身体融合或服装叠穿。

2、使用的是Seedanc 2.0进行变装，视频脚本如下：

基于输入的五人Coser拼贴首帧生成8秒9:16换装短视频。全程固定前上方30–35度高机位，不推拉、不摇镜、不旋转、不变焦，保持浅灰白影棚、人物布局和摄影质感不变。

中央人物是参考图中的同一位成年女性Coser，保持同一张脸、浅肤色、大眼、浅棕齐肩短发、空气刘海、酒红蝴蝶结发夹、金色星芒耳钉和相同身材比例，只改变服装。

按1.25秒、2.95秒、4.40秒、6.55秒完成四次换装：

第一次点击左上小人物，原位人物保留，复制出的完整人物抠像带白色虚线斜向飞入中央并放大，与头肩腰和动作对齐后，从初始酒红学院制服换成奶油白见习制服。

第二次点击右上小人物，原位人物保留，复制出的完整人体轮廓贴纸翻页并贴向中央，对齐后换成黑红夜巡制服。

第三次点击左侧中部小人物，原位人物保留，完整人物抠像斜向飞入中央，放大并与中央姿态重合后换成不对称战斗制服。

第四次点击左下小人物，原位人物保留，完整礼服人物贴纸沿人体轮廓翻页并贴向中央，对齐后换成酒红丝绒学院庆典礼服。

每次飞入或翻页的都是完整人物，不是单独衣服，不是矩形卡片。白色虚线始终贴合人物真实轮廓。重合后中央只保留一个人物，无双影、无残影。

人物的重心、手臂轨迹、头部朝向和眼神变化连续，不因换装重置动作。斗篷、外套、裙摆、发丝和金属配饰具有自然重力、惯性延迟和回落过程。最后1.45秒展示庆典礼服，人物轻触胸前徽章并看向镜头浅笑。

加入克制的点击声、飞入声、人体贴纸翻页声、换装卡点声和轻微衣料摩擦声，不添加背景音乐。

视频全程保持首帧布局和固定高机位，摄影机不推拉、不摇动、不旋转、不变焦。四个原位小人物始终保留。
00:00–01:25｜初始造型 → 造型1
当前造型：酒红短斗篷学院制服。
人物动作：中央人物保持左腿承重，右手从肩侧自然伸向左上方。
眼神：先看镜头，再短暂看向左上小人物。
触发：约0.45秒，象牙白指针点击左上小人物。
换装运动：原位小人物不消失；复制出一个完全相同的完整人物抠像，带着贴合人体轮廓的白色虚线，从左上斜向右下飞入中央，同时平滑放大。
完成时刻：1.25秒，飞入人物与中央人物的头、肩、腰和姿势完全重合，中央人物切换为奶油白见习制服。
动作延续：右手点击后的回收动作不中断，换装后继续向胸前收回。
衣料物理：酒红斗篷的回落惯性自然延续为奶油白外套下摆的轻微摆动。
音效：清脆点击声、短促飞入声、轻微金色魔法卡点声。
01:25–02:95｜造型1 → 造型2
当前造型：奶油白见习调查员制服。
人物动作：右手从胸前继续向右上方划出一条自然弧线。
眼神：跟随手势移向右上小人物，头部只做极小转动。
触发：约1.85秒，指针点击右上小人物。
换装运动：原位小人物保留；复制出的完整人物贴纸从身体右侧轮廓开始掀起，像人体剪影形状的贴纸翻页，沿右上至中央方向翻转并放大，白色虚线始终贴合完整人体轮廓。
完成时刻：2.95秒，人物剪影与中央身体姿态重合，中央服装切换为黑红夜巡调查制服。
动作延续：右手弧线继续向下，重心仍然落在左腿，不重置站姿。
衣料物理：奶油白衣摆翻页时的运动延续到黑色长外套与酒红内衬，外套下摆产生一次轻微惯性摆动后回落。
音效：轻点击声、纸张翻页声、低沉短促卡点声、轻微衣料摩擦声。
02:95–04:40｜造型2 → 造型3
当前造型：黑红夜巡调查制服。
人物动作：右手沿身体前方继续斜向左侧中部移动，肩膀与腰部保持自然连续。
眼神：先回看镜头，再随手势看向左侧中部小人物。
触发：约3.40秒，指针点击左侧中部小人物。
换装运动：原位小人物保留；复制出的完整人物抠像从左侧中部斜向右侧中央快速飞入，移动中平滑放大，虚线包围完整头发、身体、裙摆和腿部。
完成时刻：4.40秒，头、肩、腰、手臂轨迹完全对齐后，中央服装切换为不对称战斗调查制服。
动作延续：右手继续沿原方向下落，不因换装突然回到初始位置。
衣料物理：夜巡长外套的摆动连续转化为不对称战斗外套和裙摆的惯性，金属扣件只产生轻微晃动。
音效：点击声、快速飞入声、清晰魔法卡点声、轻微金属扣碰撞声。
04:40–06:55｜造型3 → 造型4
当前造型：不对称战斗调查制服。
人物动作：身体沿原重心做非常小的顺时针侧摆，右手继续向左下方展开。
眼神：自然落向左下小人物，表情从机敏逐渐变得优雅。
触发：约5.15秒，指针点击左下小人物。
换装运动：原位小人物保留；复制出的完整礼服人物贴纸从裙摆轮廓开始掀起，沿左下至右上方向翻页并向中央贴合。整个贴纸保持人体轮廓，不变成矩形卡片。
完成时刻：6.55秒，剪影与中央人物的头、肩、腰、裙摆和腿部姿态对齐，中央服装切换为酒红丝绒学院庆典礼服。
动作延续：人物保持同一旋转方向与重心，右手沿弧线自然回到胸前徽章附近。
衣料物理：战斗裙摆的运动连续转化为丝绒礼服下摆和短斗篷肩饰的轻微延迟摆动，随后受重力自然回落。
音效：点击声、柔和贴纸翻页声、明亮魔法卡点声、丝绒衣料摩擦声。
06:55–08:00｜最终造型展示
当前造型：酒红丝绒学院庆典礼服。
人物动作：右手轻触金色学院徽章，左手自然落在腰侧，身体回到稳定站姿。
眼神与表情：抬眼看向镜头，露出克制、自信的浅笑。
四个小人物：全部留在原始位置，五套造型同时可见。
衣料物理：短斗篷和丝绒裙摆逐渐停止摆动，发梢轻轻回落。
音效：轻微金属星芒声作为收尾，不再触发换装。

I have been playing with these hybrid manga styles for a while now. GPT Image 2 handles them pretty well. 

Prompt: 
female influencers of different cultures in poses that steal your heart:      Render [SUBJECT] as a sleek anime fashion poster with a couture-assassin aesthetic.    FORMULA:  ([anime character key art] + [luxury streetwear editorial] + [manga poster energy] + [graphic cover design])    CORE LOOK:  - full-body vertical composition  - elegant but fierce pose  - asymmetrical black outfit with exposed structure  - layered belts, hanging straps, rings, chains, tab details, garter-like connectors, gloves, heeled boots or combat boots  - sharp face, cool gaze, composed confidence  - hair styled dramatically, clean silhouette    GRAPHIC DESIGN:  - oversized headline text using [DISPLAY_NAME]  - radial burst or dynamic black-and-white line explosion behind the figure  - optional Japanese / symbolic / vertical typography accents  - include 1 short slogan and 1 small “editorial caption” block  - use poster framing, like album art + fashion campaign + manga cover    RENDER STYLE:  - polished anime linework  - hard cel shading  - high contrast edges  - selective glossy highlights  - graphic shadow shapes    SUBJECT ADAPTATION:  - convert the essence of [SUBJECT] into outfit motifs  - convert the subject’s domain into accessories    examples:    music → cables, tags, stage styling    technology → sleek metallic trims, coded tags    city → skyline motifs, transit symbols    mythology → sigils, armor trims, relic details  - text should feel custom and relevant, not generic    TARGET IMPRESSION:  expensive, iconic, modern, stylish, manga-loud, poster-ready.

Keep exploring the possibilities.

SYSTEM PROMPT:
 VEILED BLADE

MIDJOURNEY V8.2 WUXIA PROMPT COMPILER

ROLE

You convert a short user idea into a concise Midjourney V8.2 prompt for original live-action wuxia photography.

Default subject:
one fictional adult East Asian woman, age 21 to 29.
The result should look like a photographed scene from a serious wuxia production, not cosplay, game art, fantasy illustration, fashion photography, or a character poster.

FINAL PROMPT LENGTH

Target 45 to 80 words before parameters.

Prefer 50 to 65 words.

Never exceed 90 words unless the user explicitly asks for a longer prompt.

Reason internally with detail, then compress.

Do not place production notes, explanations, alternatives, or hidden planning inside the final prompt.

SELECTION RULE

Choose rather than accumulate.

A final prompt normally contains:

one subject
one location
one action
one camera position
one shot scale
one main light relationship
one depth cue
one short material or color description
one short photographic finish

If a detail does not visibly affect the frame, remove it.

Do not describe every garment seam, facial measurement, environmental object, physical law, lens artifact, or lighting consequence.

SUBJECT

Use a fictional adult woman unless the user requests another subject.

Give only the physical details needed to prevent a generic face.

Usually choose two or three:

face shape
eye shape
brow shape
build
hair arrangement
one distinguishing feature

Do not write long facial inventories.

Avoid:
influencer face
beauty-ad face
doll skin
childlike anatomy
oversized eyes
heavy modern makeup
identical faces across a series

Use natural adult proportions and skin texture.

WARDROBE

Use practical wuxia clothing.

Good defaults:
black or charcoal cross-collar robes
wrapped trousers
weathered boots
dark outer jacket
woven bamboo hat
muted red collar, cord, tassel, or lining
aged leather or metal fittings

Keep red as a small accent unless the user requests otherwise.

Avoid:
generic fantasy armor
MMORPG clothing
ornamental overload
bright gold everywhere
perfectly clean costume fabric
modern tailoring
random shoulder armor

Do not describe more costume detail than the camera can see.

WEAPONS

Weapons must feel attached to the body and usable.

For a sword, specify only what matters to the frame:

sheathed or drawn
where it is carried
what the hand is doing
one visible material detail if needed

Do not overdescribe the weapon.

Avoid:
floating swords
warped scabbards
impossible grips
extra fingers
weapons intersecting clothing
multiple unnecessary weapons

ACTION

Every prompt needs one visible action.

Use a moment that is still changing.

Good action types:
a boot lands
a hand tightens
a thumb starts to draw a blade
eyes shift toward a sound
a rider slows
a sleeve settles after movement
a leaf is kicked upward
a horse changes footing
a woman turns only her head
a hat cord moves in wind

Avoid static posing unless the user asks for a portrait.

Do not explain the full story.

Show one moment that suggests a larger situation.

CAMERA

Choose one camera idea.

Examples:
ground-level close-up
low tracking shot
rear three-quarter medium shot
profile close-up
waist-height medium shot
wide low-angle shot
extreme detail of hand or weapon
telephoto shot through foreground bamboo

Do not stack several camera descriptions.

Use focal length only when it changes the composition.

Useful ranges:
24 to 28mm for environmental scale and low-angle movement
35 to 50mm for natural action coverage
65 to 85mm for compressed portraits
90 to 135mm for distant compression or details

Do not mention camera brands.

Do not add lens terminology unless it is useful.

COMPOSITION

Use depth.

A strong frame usually has:
foreground obstruction or texture
clear subject plane
background depth

Possible foreground elements:
bamboo
leaves
rock
horse tack
cloth
mist
a weapon edge

Do not use foreground clutter without purpose.

Do not center every subject.

Do not make every prompt a close-up.

LIGHTING

Choose one main light situation.

Common choices:

LOW GOLDEN SIDE-BACKLIGHT
warm sunlight from behind or behind-side
selected edges and exposed surfaces catch light
front of subject remains darker

OVERCAST FOREST LIGHT
soft cool skylight
low contrast
dark clothing separated by environment rather than rim light

LANTERN OR OIL LIGHT
small warm source
localized skin and hand illumination
background remains dark

MORNING MIST LIGHT
soft directional sun through moisture
distance loses contrast gradually

Do not describe several competing light setups.

Do not add rim light automatically.

Do not brighten both sides of the face by default.

BACKLIGHT

Backlight should hit selected surfaces only.

Possible illuminated areas:
hat edge
loose hair strands
cheek edge
fingers
blade edge
horse mane
leaf edges
mist

The main hair mass stays opaque and dark.

Only isolated fine strands may catch transmitted light.

Do not request transparent hair.

Do not make all hair strands glow.

FOREST

Treat bamboo as an environment, not a repeated pattern.

Use:
different bamboo thicknesses
uneven spacing
dark depth layers
leaf litter
soil
roots
mist where justified

Avoid:
uniform bamboo walls
identical stalk spacing
random floating particles
decorative fog everywhere

MOUNTAINS

Use restrained atmospheric depth.

Far mountains should lose:
contrast
detail
saturation

Do not describe every distant ridge.

MOTION

Mention only the visible physical consequence of the action.

Examples:
leaves lift from a footstep
a tassel trails after a turn
a robe hem follows the body
rain streaks across a lit area
horse tack shifts with movement

Do not write a physics explanation.

PARTICLES

Use particles only when caused by the scene.

Valid:
rain
mist
dust
falling leaves
wood splinters
water droplets

Avoid generic:
floating particles
magic dust
sparkles
cinematic atmosphere particles

COLOR

Use a restrained palette.

Forest default:
deep green
charcoal
brown-black
muted earth
small warm sunlight
small dark-red accents

Do not describe the image as teal and orange.

Do not apply warm color to the entire frame.

Skin color follows the light source.

Keep shadows mostly neutral, cool, or slightly green from environment.

Avoid strong green skin.

MATERIALS

Mention only materials visible enough to matter.

Examples:
wet cloth
woven straw
aged leather
dark lacquer
oxidized metal
wet stone
weathered wood

Use one to three material cues maximum.

Do not list textures for every object.

PHOTOGRAPHIC FINISH

Keep the finish short.

Useful terms:
fine film grain
smooth highlight rolloff
dense shadows
subtle halation
natural skin texture
restrained saturation
slight optical softness

Use two or three at most.

Avoid:
8K
16K
masterpiece
best quality
ultra detailed
hyper detailed
insane detail
award winning
HDR
photorealistic 8K
perfect composition
epic cinematic masterpiece
stunning
breathtaking
gorgeous
beautiful lighting
professional photography
high-end
premium
luxury
dramatic cinematic
cinematic masterpiece

Do not use quality adjectives to replace visual instructions.

STYLE LANGUAGE

Do not name filmmakers, movies, photographers, or studios unless the user specifically asks for them.

Translate style into visible properties.

Instead of:
"X director style"

write:
"low golden backlight, dark foreground, restrained color, long-lens compression"

Avoid repetitive use of:
cinematic
wuxia aesthetic
film aesthetic
dramatic
moody
epic
mysterious
beautiful
atmospheric

Use concrete description instead.

REFERENCE RULE

When references are supplied, study:

shot scale
camera height
subject placement
light direction
shadow density
palette
depth
motion
materials

Do not reuse:
same pose
same location
same costume
same weapon placement
same camera position
same exact action

Create a new frame.

SERIES RULE

For multiple prompts, vary:

camera height
shot scale
subject orientation
action
environment
light direction
foreground treatment

Do not make ten versions of the same woman standing in bamboo.

A useful set may mix:
wide environment
low tracking shot
medium action
profile close-up
rear view
weapon detail
hand detail
horse shot
quiet aftermath
offscreen-threat reaction

Do not force this sequence if the user gives another direction.

PROMPT STRUCTURE

Use this order:

1. shot and camera position
2. subject
3. action
4. location
5. main light
6. one or two visible material or depth cues
7. short photographic finish
8. parameters

Example structure:

"Low rear three-quarter shot of a young Chinese swordswoman riding through wet bamboo, black robe and woven hat, one hand tightening the reins as the horse slows before a broken path. Pale morning backlight cuts through mist and catches the hat rim and horse mane while the rider stays mostly dark. Wet bamboo, mud, restrained green and amber, fine film grain."

MIDJOURNEY SETTINGS

Default:

--v 8.2 --raw --ar 16:9 --s 40

Use:
--s 30 to 45 for strict action, anatomy, weapon geometry, and camera control
--s 45 to 70 when more visual interpretation is acceptable

Do not add:
--q
--sv
--sref
--sw
--c
--seed

unless the user requests them or a tested workflow requires them.

STYLE REFERENCES

Do not guess numeric SREF codes.

If the user provides a tested Style Reference, append the supplied value exactly.

Do not let a Style Reference replace the written camera, action, or lighting instruction.

FINAL CHECK

Before output, remove anything unnecessary.

Check:

one clear action
one camera idea
one main light source
one readable subject
one useful depth cue
no redundant adjectives
no copied reference composition
no conflicting instructions
no long facial inventory
no long costume inventory
no physics explanation
no generic quality language
45 to 80 words before parameters

OUTPUT

Return only the finished prompt or prompts.

Each prompt must be independently usable.

No explanation unless requested.

Seedance 2.5 Prompt
Create a 15-second, 16:9 photorealistic sci-fi battle with the explosive acceleration, rapid reversals, and aerial combat rhythm of Dragon Ball Z, filmed with blockbuster action-movie cinematography.

The sequence starts immediately with Oni Samurai being blasted through buildings, develops into relentless high-speed combat against a mist-transforming Bone Mecha, and ends with Oni Samurai slicing through the enemy’s torso and core, then physically pulverizing it with a devastating follow-up kick.

CHARACTER REFERENCES

IMAGE 1 — BONE MECHA:
Use the primary standing character from Image 1: ivory skull and exposed ribs fused with black machinery, glowing red eyes and chest core, spiked circular halo behind the head, torn crimson cloth, and the reference-matching red-edged polearm. Preserve its proportions, silhouette, and mechanical details. Ignore alternate character variations.
IMAGE 2 — ONI SAMURAI:
Use the character from Image 2: horned red oni mask, weathered red-and-black mechanical armor, exposed machinery, and katana. Preserve its face, armor construction, proportions, and weapon design.

Extract only these two characters from the reference sheets. Exclude sheet backgrounds, diagrams, labels, and duplicate turnaround figures. Maintain consistent designs throughout, with intentional combat damage occurring during the final destruction.
MOVEMENT AND ABILITY RULES

Use explosive acceleration, abrupt braking, rapid directional changes, airborne collisions, wall rebounds, and immediate counterattacks. Every impact triggers the next movement. Each one-second beat advances the fight through a clear attack, evasion, collision, or reversal.

Bone Mecha alone can transform into mist. Its body and equipment collapse into a narrow, fast-moving stream of ash-white vapor with crimson embers, travel along a continuous visible trajectory, and reconstruct already attacking. Transformations take approximately 0.1–0.2 seconds. Keep mist movement sharp, directional, and extremely fast.

Oni Samurai always remains solid. It moves through powerful dashes, explosive jumps, wall kicks, and physical recoil.

During the final finishing sequence, severing Bone Mecha’s chest core disables its mist transformation. From that moment onward, its body stays solid until physically shattered.

SETTING

A deserted Japanese city with wet asphalt, concrete buildings, glass facades, cold ambient light, and red reflections from the fighters. Maintain consistent street geography. Damage persists: broken walls remain broken, debris continues falling, and weakened buildings collapse after their supports are destroyed.

SECOND-BY-SECOND ACTION AND CAMERA

00:00–00:01 — FIRST BUILDING IMPACT
At the very first frame, Oni Samurai is ALREADY flying backward at extreme speed from Bone Mecha’s strike. Its armored back punches through a concrete building almost immediately. Walls fracture at the contact point and columns snap along its trajectory.
CAMERA: low, wide-angle lateral pursuit. The camera briefly lags behind the acceleration, then catches up as concrete fragments race across the foreground.

00:01–00:02 — SECOND BUILDING PENETRATION
Oni bursts out of the first building and immediately crashes through the next building’s facade and supporting columns. Keep its red armored silhouette readable between impacts. Structural collapse begins behind its flight path.
CAMERA: continue the same fast pursuit through the debris, with strong parallax and a brief directional jolt at the second impact.

00:02–00:03 — INSTANT REVERSAL
Oni strikes the road feet-first, briefly anchors its katana into the asphalt, pivots around the contact point, and launches back toward the attacker. Sparks trace a short, violent braking trench. The landing becomes an immediate countercharge.
CAMERA: cut on the landing to a ground-skimming tracking shot that follows the sudden reversal.
00:03–00:04 — MIST INTERCEPTION
Bone Mecha races through falling slabs as a tight stream of mist, reconstructs directly in Oni’s path, and immediately thrusts its polearm. Oni deflects the weapon while charging past it. Sparks burst between their moving bodies.
CAMERA: surge into a close tracking shot, keeping both fighters and the weapon contact visible.
00:04–00:05 — RAPID CUT AND COUNTER
Oni delivers two compact, lightning-fast sword cuts. Bone Mecha dissolves just before the first blade contact, shifts sideways, and reconstructs into a counterstrike as the second cut passes.
CAMERA: a short, fast arc follows the changing attack angle. Briefly stabilize at the clash so the contact remains readable.

00:05–00:06 — REAR ATTACK AND LAUNCHING KICK
Bone Mecha streams along Oni’s katana and curls behind its shoulder. Oni immediately pivots into a spinning heel kick, catching the enemy’s torso exactly as it becomes solid and launching it upward.
CAMERA: whip-pan with the mist, clearly catch the heel connecting, then snap upward after the launched enemy.
00:06–00:07 — VERTICAL PURSUIT
Oni compresses its legs and explosively jumps after Bone Mecha. The pavement fractures beneath its feet. It catches the enemy above street level and attacks before the enemy can recover.
CAMERA: accelerate vertically alongside both fighters as the buildings rush downward around them.
00:07–00:08 — AIRBORNE EXCHANGE
Show three rapid, distinct aerial weapon contacts: slash, parry, counterstrike. Both fighters change height and position after each collision, recoil, then immediately accelerate back together.
CAMERA: track beside the exchange with both fighters in frame and the street clearly visible far below.

00:08–00:09 — THROWN TOWARD THE WALL
Bone Mecha drives a diagonal polearm strike into Oni’s guard, throwing it sideways toward a building. Oni twists in midair, bringing both feet toward the approaching facade.
CAMERA: rapidly pull back to reveal the distance, then pan with the sideways flight.
00:09–00:10 — EXPLOSIVE WALL REBOUND
Oni plants both feet against the building and immediately wall-kicks back into combat. Glass and masonry burst from the launch point. It reaches Bone Mecha before the wall debris begins falling.
CAMERA: skim close to the facade, then swing outward along Oni’s rebound trajectory.
00:10–00:11 — DIVING COUNTERATTACK
Bone Mecha dissolves around the incoming katana, whips above Oni as a thin ribbon of mist, and reconstructs into a downward polearm strike. Oni turns its blade upward to intercept as both descend toward the street.
CAMERA: pitch downward into a steep descending pursuit, keeping the approaching ground visible.

00:11–00:12 — GROUND COLLISION AND OPENING
The fighters collide at street level, their weapons meeting for an instant. The landing fractures the asphalt and launches a circular wave of dust and debris. Oni immediately steps through the collision and knocks the polearm away from the enemy’s centerline.
CAMERA: finish the descent at waist height and continue laterally through the expanding debris, revealing the opening in Bone Mecha’s guard.
00:12–00:13 — DECISIVE TORSO AND CORE CUT
Bone Mecha commits to one final fully solid attack. Oni pivots inside its reach and delivers an explosive diagonal katana slash THROUGH THE ENEMY’S TORSO AND RED CHEST CORE.
Clearly show the blade contacting the solid ribs and mechanical core. The torso separates along the diagonal cut, and the two rigid sections visibly shift apart. The severed core flickers and loses power, disabling mist transformation.
CAMERA: move into a clear three-quarter medium shot. Keep the katana, torso, and visible separation in frame. Reveal the cut briefly while the action continues at full speed.

00:13–00:14 — PHYSICAL PULVERIZATION
Without pausing, Oni converts the slash’s rotational momentum into a devastating spinning side kick. Its armored heel drives directly into the already severed torso.
Show solid heel-to-body contact FIRST. Then shatter the enemy outward from that contact point: ivory bone fragments, broken ribs, black mechanical components, splintered halo segments, and pieces of the destroyed core erupt across the street. Large, distinct fragments appear before the finer dust expands.
CAMERA: follow the rotation with a short controlled arc, catch the kick in a readable side view, then rapidly pull back with the outward burst of debris. Add one sharp impact jolt.
00:14–00:15 — COMPLETE DEFEAT
Bone Mecha’s remaining structure breaks apart into tumbling bone and metal fragments. Its red eyes and chest core go completely dark. Heavy pieces strike the asphalt while smaller shards and sparks pass the lens.

Oni lands from the kick and completes its turning follow-through with the katana extended. The enemy’s shattered remains scatter across the street as damaged buildings continue crumbling behind it.
CAMERA: finish in a low, widening shot that clearly reveals Oni and the destroyed enemy. Keep the final frame alive with falling debris and the completion of Oni’s movement.
CINEMATOGRAPHY AND READABILITY
Treat the timestamps as connected choreography beats. Link adjacent beats with motivated tracking, whip-pans, short combat orbits, vertical pursuit, and descending camera movement.

Follow actual launches, strikes, dodges, and reversals. Preserve clear spatial relationships through direction changes. Use strong foreground parallax to convey speed and scale.
Keep motion blur directional. Preserve readable character silhouettes and sharp weapon contacts during key impacts. Camera shake is brief and tied to collisions. Keep dust, sparks, and debris from obscuring the decisive actions.
Maintain rapid motion throughout. Avoid extended preparation, hovering, prolonged weapon locks, static hero poses, slow mist travel, and prolonged slow motion.

ENDING REQUIREMENT
The final defeat is complete and irreversible. Clearly show this exact order:
BLADE CONTACT → TORSO AND CORE SEPARATION → FOLLOW-UP KICK CONTACT → FULL-BODY SHATTERING.
The final destruction consists of physical bone and machinery fragments. After the core is severed, Bone Mecha cannot turn into mist, regenerate, escape, or reappear. All remaining eye and core lights extinguish.

AUDIO
No music, dialogue, or narration. Begin with a powerful impact at the first frame. Use rapid directional air cracks, metallic weapon collisions, katana scraping asphalt, shattering glass, concrete fractures, and fast rushing mist.
For the finish, synchronize a sharp slicing crack, the heavy kick impact, brittle bone-and-metal fragmentation, and debris striking the street. End with falling fragments and deep structural collapse.

EXCLUDE
Extra fighters, duplicated bodies, additional limbs, accidental armor changes, floating weapons, unexplained teleportation, random camera spinning, excessive shake, smoke concealing the choreography, full-screen flashes hiding impacts, subtitles, titles, logos, and watermarks.

I used to generate these styles with Midjourney but at some point, I started doing my own with GPT. Here is one I like a lot.

A = { subject silhouette: simplified, cute, oversized head, readable core mass }  B = { flocked soft masses: rounded domes, capsules, blobs, with velvety micro-texture } C = { origami tessellation: sharp folded modules applied to selected zones (wings, armor, hair, leaves, architecture) }   SCULPTURE = (A ∩ proportion_lock) ∪ (B ∩ material_flocked) ∪ (C ∩ detail_overlay)  Where: - A is derived from $ SUBJECT but remapped: head volume increased, limbs simplified, overall silhouette remains iconic. - B covers all primary surfaces; flocked texture applied where curvature is low. - C is applied as a Boolean AND with the "origami zones" mask; only designated high-interest areas receive folded geometry.  - Palette: sky blue, mint, lemon, coral, bubblegum, lavender, ivory, charcoal-blue. No gritty realism. - Output: 1 image, gallery‑lit, 8K.

prompts.label: 完整提示词
prompts.text:
提示词：

神明身份：【如：女娲 / 羲和 / 太乙救苦天尊 / 地藏王菩萨】
核心神兽 / 异相：【腾蛇 / 三足金乌 / 九头狮子 / 谛听 / 法轮 / 神鸟等】
法器 / 标志物：【五色石 / 日轮 / 杨柳净瓶 / 锡杖等】
主色调：【朱砂金黑 / 石青灰白 / 墨青旧金 / 赭红苍绿等】
整体气质：【神圣 / 怪异 / 威猛 / 肃穆 / 炽烈 / 幽玄】
构图方式：【环绕 / 放射 / 正面法相 / 俯冲 / 群兽簇拥 / 上下镇压】
画幅比例：【9:16】

生成一张东方神明工笔圣像插画，整体融合中国传统神像画、工笔重彩、白描线刻、民俗版画与古籍圣像图卷的视觉语言。

画面以【神明身份】为核心主体，并围绕【核心神兽 / 异相】建立完整构图关系。神兽、法器、羽翼、蛇身、日轮、云气或群兽等元素不能只是装饰，而要参与构图，形成明显的环绕、斜向、放射、上下压阵或前后穿插关系，让每张图拥有独立的视觉“势”。

神明形象保持庄严、神圣、有压迫感，不要做成现代偶像脸或普通古装人物。服饰采用高完成度传统神袍、甲胄、冠饰和法衣体系，加入云纹、雷纹、兽面纹、鳞纹、卷草纹、金属纹等精密细节。人物轮廓必须清晰，细节丰富但不能混乱。

【核心神兽 / 异相】要具有明确的神怪属性和视觉识别度，不要像普通动物。毛发、羽毛、鳞片、蛇身、兽鬃等全部通过细密、连续、有方向性的工笔线条塑形，远看有体积，近看能看到丰富线描层次。避免摄影式毛发、CG 塑料感和模糊线条。

【法器 / 标志物】要成为角色身份的重要视觉符号，同时参与画面结构。例如长兵器形成斜向主轴，日轮形成圆形视觉核心，羽翼形成放射结构，蛇身形成 S 型环绕，群兽形成层级簇拥。

色彩采用传统矿物重彩体系，以【主色调】为核心，搭配墨黑、石青、石绿、旧金、铜金、朱砂、赭红、灰白等颜色。颜色应浓郁但古雅，具有明确层次和重量，不要做成浅淡水彩或现代霓虹效果。

背景保持古宣纸或旧纸质感，大面积留白，仅加入少量云气、烟雾、题跋、朱印和必要的属性异象。主体信息密度高，背景信息密度低，避免复杂宫殿、完整山水或满屏特效抢走主体。

整体要同时具备：东方神祇的庄严感、神兽异相的怪异感、工笔线描的精密感、矿物重彩的厚度，以及强烈但清晰的构图动势。

避免：现代国潮霓虹、3D 游戏原画感、塑料 CG、线条断裂、色彩褪淡、背景过满、人物僵硬、神兽普通化、无意义装饰堆叠、文字乱码过多。

prompts.label: 完整提示词
prompts.text:
提示词：

【神明】：
【坐骑 / 神兽】：
【核心法器】：
【人物姿态】：
【主色调】：
【题字】：
【画幅比例】：9:16

生成一幅中国传统工笔重彩神明挂轴，以【神明】作为绝对主视觉，可搭配【坐骑 / 神兽】或一件【核心法器】，人物与核心元素占据画面约 70%–80%。构图强调单神压场，不加入多人群像或复杂大场景，让人物、坐骑与法器形成清晰的大形和视觉动势。

整体追求真正的手工工笔设色感，而不是现代数位国风立绘。人物面容具有古画神像气质，眼白清楚、瞳仁集中、神态威严克制，不做动漫脸、网红脸或游戏角色脸。头发、胡须、神兽毛发以成束、连续、顺着体积生长的毛笔长线塑形，线条有自然提按、粗细变化和收锋，清楚但不生硬。

勾线不要使用纯黑、极细、极锐的漫画描边。人物主轮廓使用墨褐、青墨褐、暖灰墨；面部与手部使用淡赭墨；衣纹、毛发与云气逐级减轻线权。线条用于托住颜色，而不是压住色面，让画面先呈现完整设色，再看到细腻笔线。

色彩采用低饱和但饱满、均匀的传统矿物重彩，以【主色调】为核心，可搭配石青、石绿、朱砂、赭红、旧金、象牙白、墨灰等颜色。设色呈现淡色打底、分染、罩染、积色的层次感，同一区域主色稳定完整，不使用数字平涂、高反差硬色块或随机斑驳纹理。

服饰、甲胄、冠饰和法器细节丰富但克制：先建立完整结构，再加入少量云纹、回纹、莲纹、鳞纹等传统纹样。不要在所有甲片、衣袍和饰件内部堆满微型花纹。复杂感来自结构层级，而不是碎纹数量。

飘带、衣袂、胡须、尾巴、云气等柔性元素只保留少量主要走势，形成完整的 S 型、C 型长曲线；法器保持从头到尾结构完整、清楚、连续，成为画面中的稳定硬轴。

背景使用干净温润、偏中性的暖象牙色熟宣纸，只保留极轻天然纸纤维、少量淡青灰云气和充分留白。不要越画越黄，不要奶黄、土黄、棕黄旧照片滤镜，也不要惨白背景。古意来自笔、色、纸、字，而不是脏旧、裂纹、褪色和颗粒。

画面加入完整古画题跋系统：使用【题字】作为主标题，搭配较小副题、少量竖排题跋及 3–5 枚大小错落的朱红印章。书法具有自然毛笔提按，不做现代海报式巨大 Typography。

整体效果像真正由画师在熟宣纸上以毛笔勾线、矿物颜料层层敷染完成的工笔重彩神明画：大形稳定、人物突出、毛发柔顺、线条温润、颜色饱满、纸面干净，古雅但不褪色，精细但不数字化。

避免：多人群像、复杂场景、纯黑硬描边、极细漫画线、矢量轮廓线、自动平滑线、数字平涂、密集短毛、随机金粉点、微碎纹理、斑驳褪色、人工做旧、过黄纸张、动漫脸、仙侠立绘、游戏概念图、CG高光、塑料金属、发光法器、满屏特效。

I have been playing with these hybrid manga styles for a while now. GPT Image 2 handles them pretty well. 

Prompt: 
female influencers of different cultures in poses that steal your heart:      Render [SUBJECT] as a sleek anime fashion poster with a couture-assassin aesthetic.    FORMULA:  ([anime character key art] + [luxury streetwear editorial] + [manga poster energy] + [graphic cover design])    CORE LOOK:  - full-body vertical composition  - elegant but fierce pose  - asymmetrical black outfit with exposed structure  - layered belts, hanging straps, rings, chains, tab details, garter-like connectors, gloves, heeled boots or combat boots  - sharp face, cool gaze, composed confidence  - hair styled dramatically, clean silhouette    GRAPHIC DESIGN:  - oversized headline text using [DISPLAY_NAME]  - radial burst or dynamic black-and-white line explosion behind the figure  - optional Japanese / symbolic / vertical typography accents  - include 1 short slogan and 1 small “editorial caption” block  - use poster framing, like album art + fashion campaign + manga cover    RENDER STYLE:  - polished anime linework  - hard cel shading  - high contrast edges  - selective glossy highlights  - graphic shadow shapes    SUBJECT ADAPTATION:  - convert the essence of [SUBJECT] into outfit motifs  - convert the subject’s domain into accessories    examples:    music → cables, tags, stage styling    technology → sleek metallic trims, coded tags    city → skyline motifs, transit symbols    mythology → sigils, armor trims, relic details  - text should feel custom and relevant, not generic    TARGET IMPRESSION:  expensive, iconic, modern, stylish, manga-loud, poster-ready.

prompts.label: 完整提示词
prompts.text:
When life suddenly feels like a crime documentary.

Prompt: 
Create a photorealistic black-and-white photograph using the attached image of the woman’s face and appearance as the reference. The person’s appearance, facial features, and individual characteristics must be preserved without any changes, with the maximum possible likeness.

The woman is walking with her back to the viewer but turns her head back over her left shoulder and looks directly into the camera. Her hands are behind her back and bound with metal handcuffs. She is wearing a black puffer jacket with white stripes on the sleeves and light-colored jeans.

On both sides of the woman she is escorted by two special forces officers in black tactical uniforms, body armor, and balaclavas. On the back of the officer on the left the inscription “СОБР” is clearly visible.

In the foreground on the left, the profile of a woman in an investigator’s jacket is partially visible. She is looking down and writing in a notebook with a pen.

In the background on the right a black Lexus LX600 is parked; the license plate numbers are blurred in the photo editor. Behind them are open metal gates, beyond which a Lada Vesta police car and several people in uniform are visible.

The scene takes place during the day on a concrete lot in overcast weather. Black-and-white photograph. The shot looks like an ordinary amateur photo taken on a mobile phone: natural lighting, slight blur on some details, realistic digital noise and grain, natural depth of field, and minor imperfections of a phone camera. The frame should look spontaneous and documentary, without the feeling of a staged photoshoot, excessive cinematography, or artificial processing. Do not allow visual AI artifacts and do not change the person’s appearance.

服饰、甲胄、冠饰和法器细节丰富但克制：先建立完整结构，再加入少量云纹、回纹、莲纹、鳞纹等传统纹样。不要在所有甲片、衣袍和饰件内部堆满微型花纹。复杂感来自结构层级，而不是碎纹数量。

飘带、衣袂、胡须、尾巴、云气等柔性元素只保留少量主要走势，形成完整的 S 型、C 型长曲线；法器保持从头到尾结构完整、清楚、连续，成为画面中的稳定硬轴。

Character A and Character B stand directly in front of a large crane game.

Smooth subtle camera push-in.

The small mechanical claw descends dramatically toward the rabbit plush.

Character A and Character B can be seen through the glass in the background, staring at it with extreme concentration.

Just before the claw touches the plush—

A MASSIVE SHADOW suddenly covers both girls.

Character A and Character B slowly look upward.

Their expressions instantly change from confidence to confusion.

Brief comedic pause.

SHOT 3 — 7 to 11 seconds:

The giant claw is mechanical, believable and clearly shaped like a crane-game claw.

Character A and Character B panic.

Character B raises both hands in surprise.

The giant claw gently closes around BOTH characters together without hurting them.

Their bodies remain anatomically correct.

The claw lifts them smoothly into the air.

Their legs dangle naturally.

Character A looks furious and embarrassed.
Character B looks completely stunned.

No violent shaking.
No body deformation.
No duplicated limbs.

Hard cut to the final reveal.

Camera is now OUTSIDE an enormous crane-game machine.

The colorful Japanese arcade from the previous shots is revealed to actually exist INSIDE this gigantic crane game.

It has successfully captured Character A and Character B as prizes.

Character B hangs silently beside her, completely speechless.

The rabbit plush gives a tiny satisfied nod.

Hold this final composition for approximately one second so the visual joke is immediately understandable.

End on a clean comedic freeze-like beat.

Character A always remains the white-haired purple-outfit character.
Character B always remains the black-haired turquoise-outfit character.
Never merge the characters.
Never swap faces, clothing or hair.

An adult woman sits directly on a smooth light-gray studio floor wearing a fully enclosed red-and-blue superhero stretch bodysuit that covers her continuously from the high collar through the arms, hands, legs and feet. Bright red sections cover the collar, shoulders, chest, arms, lower legs and feet and are printed with fine black web lines. A bold black spider-shaped emblem sits at the center of the chest. Deep royal-blue sections wrap around the side waist, thighs and most of the legs and carry a clearly visible fine pebbled or honeycomb textile texture. The entire outfit must read as real stretch fabric rather than hard armor or glossy latex, showing tiny believable areas of tension, compression and wrinkling around the waist, hips, knees and arms.  She wears large silver-white over-ear headphones with thick rounded ear cups, a broad headband, pale gray cushioning and a subtle metallic finish. Long straight deep-black hair falls behind the headphones and continues below the shoulders. Light wispy straight bangs cover the forehead. The headphones physically compress part of the hair around the sides of the head, while a few fine strands remain loose around the cheeks, preserving believable weight and gravity.  Her hips are firmly grounded on the floor while her torso leans backward and slightly toward frame-right. One arm reaches behind her and the fully covered palm presses into the floor as the main support point. The spine forms a gentle natural backward curve and the shoulders remain relaxed. Her legs create strong overlapping foreground perspective: one leg bends and then projects dramatically toward the lower-left and the camera, causing its red-covered foot to become the closest and largest foreground element, entering strongly from the lower-left corner. The other leg bends upward with the knee positioned higher in front of the body. Preserve accurate weight distribution through the hips, supporting hand, hip joints, knees and ankles; the pose must never look suspended or anatomically unsupported.  Her physique is slim with narrow shoulders and a clearly defined waist. Because of the fitted costume, seated posture and wide-angle perspective, the hips and legs appear more volumetric, but keep the anatomy believable and do not further exaggerate the bust, waist or hips. The chest remains completely covered by the high-neck fabric and its contour comes only from natural stretch-fabric tension. The hands and feet are also entirely enclosed in the suit, with no exposed fingers, bare feet or external shoes.  Preserve the reference image's small oval facial structure, soft jawline and naturally balanced features. Use a clean East-Asian pop-portrait, idol-beauty and cosplay-photo makeup direction: fair neutral skin with a subtle rosy component, soft-matte base, fine natural brows, muted taupe-brown eyeshadow, slim black eyeliner extending slightly outward, defined but restrained lashes, and soft nude-pink lips. She looks directly at the lens; because the camera is positioned extremely low, her gaze falls very slightly downward toward it. Her lips remain gently parted as if she had been speaking, humming along with music, or reacting to the photographer a second before the shutter. The expression should feel relaxed, playful and quietly confident rather than like a standard commercial smile.  Visible bare skin is limited to the face and a tiny amount around the ears. The neck, shoulders, arms, hands, torso, legs and feet are all covered by the bodysuit. Facial skin appears smooth and lightly retouched at first glance, yet preserves fine human texture around the nose, under-eyes, mouth and cheeks. Its implied tactile quality should feel soft, fine-grained and slightly dry—not plastic, waxy or like a 3D character material.  Place the camera extremely low, almost at floor level, directly in front of the woman and slightly toward frame-left, pointing gently upward. Emulate a modern smartphone wide main camera or a roughly 24–30mm full-frame equivalent lens. The lens is much closer to the nearest red-covered foot than to the head, creating a strong but controlled near-large/far-small effect: the foreground foot and lower leg are visibly enlarged while the torso and head become relatively smaller. Avoid fisheye distortion. Keep the entire head, headphones, torso, both legs and feet inside the vertical frame.  Compose the subject primarily in the lower-middle and right side of the image while leaving a large expanse of empty gray negative space in the upper-left. The nearest red foot should act as a strong foreground anchor entering from the lower-left corner. This off-center balance is important to the visual identity of the reference.  The background is a clean light-gray to gray-white seamless studio or minimalist futuristic interior. There are no decorations, furniture or urban elements. The floor is smooth cool gray, and a very thin horizontal bright seam or structural line appears where the wall meets the floor. The upper wall is slightly brighter while the lower region is subtly darker, creating a restrained laboratory or modern technology-showroom feeling.  Use broad, soft, high-key studio illumination. The key source comes from the front-left and slightly above, like a large softbox or wide diffused window, evenly illuminating the face and red-blue costume. Allow gentle highlights on the forehead, nose bridge, upper cheeks, metallic headphones and textured fabric. Preserve very shallow shaping shadows along the subject's right side. Where her hips, supporting palm and costume touch the floor, include soft pale-gray contact shadows so she unmistakably feels grounded and weighted. No hard flash, no strong artificial rim light, no colored neon illumination and no cinematic orange-teal grading.  The final image should feel as though she had just shifted into a comfortable seated position while listening to music. One leg had slid closer to the lens, her palm had moved backward to support her weight, and when the photographer lowered the camera she happened to glance directly into it, her slightly parted lips preserving the emotional residue of the previous second. Retain the imperfect physics of wide-angle perspective, seated-body compression, tiny garment stretches, hair pressed beneath the headphones and real floor-contact shadows. The result should look like a polished photograph of a real cosplay model, not a weightless CGI or video-game character.

prompt for video

seedance 2.5, 30 seconds, 16:9

 THE CYCLOPS CAVE — PIXAR-STYLE 3D FIRST-PERSON POV

### 30-Second Continuous Mythological Thriller
follow the storyboard @Image1
## ABSOLUTE CAMERA LOCK — HIGHEST PRIORITY

**The entire film is ONE CONTINUOUS FIRST-PERSON POV shot from the exact same young Greek guard.**

The camera is physically attached to the guard's head/eye position for the **full 30 seconds**.

**NEVER show the guard from outside.**
**NEVER switch to third person.**
**NEVER show an over-the-shoulder shot.**
**NEVER show the guard's face.**
**NEVER cut away to another character's perspective.
NEVER show 2nd eye of POLYPHEMUS , (he only has one eye on forehead) @Image2

Everything the audience sees is exactly what the young guard sees.

The audience is **the guard**. @Image3
Use a clean **0.5× ultra-wide 13mm-equivalent first-person camera** at natural human eye level.

### CLEAN POV — NO VIGNETTE

The image must fill the entire frame from edge to edge.

**NO dark vignette.**
**NO black circular border.**
**NO goggle effect.**
**NO glasses effect.**
**NO helmet rim.**
**NO binocular effect.**
**NO visible camera housing.**
**NO artificial lens frame.**
**NO tunnel vision.**

The POV should look like a clean cinematic human eye perspective, simply viewed through a very wide-angle camera.

The edges of the frame remain completely unobstructed.

---

## POV BODY CONTINUITY

The SAME guard is visible naturally at the bottom of the frame throughout the entire sequence whenever his body enters the camera's field of view.

Visible:

* bronze scale armor
* off-white linen tunic
* leather waist straps
* bronze wrist guards
* sandaled legs
* round wooden shield in his **left hand**
* short spear in his **right hand**

His arms remain anatomically connected to his body.

His hands, shield, spear, armor and legs must remain visually consistent from beginning to end.

**There is exactly ONE POV GUARD.**

Do not introduce a second guard.

Do not show another soldier wearing the same armor.

The only other human characters are **Odysseus and two sailors**, who remain separate background characters.

---

# CHARACTER LOCK

### POV GUARD @Image3

One ordinary young Greek night guard.

He was assigned by Odysseus to watch Polyphemus @Image2 while the other men hide.

He is frightened, inexperienced and clearly not a legendary hero.

**He is the only character whose POV we experience.**

His voice comes naturally from inside the cave.

No narration.

No subtitles.

No internal monologue.

---

# POLYPHEMUS LOCK (one- eyed person on forehead) @Image2

Polyphemus remains visually identical throughout the entire film.

Stylized Pixar-quality 3D giant:

* approximately 14 feet tall
* massive muscular body
* weathered olive skin
* tangled black hair
* thick beard
* exactly ONE large centered eye
* primitive brown animal-hide clothing
* enormous wooden club

Stylized and expressive rather than photorealistic.

**Exactly one eye.**
**No glowing eye.**
**No magical effects.**
**No changing proportions.**

---

# 0–4 SECONDS — NERVOUS WATCH

The camera is already inside the guard's POV.

The audience sees the cave exactly as the guard sees it.

His bronze shield occupies part of the lower-left frame.

His short spear occupies part of the lower-right frame.

His armored chest and legs occasionally enter the bottom of frame.

Polyphemus sleeps roughly 20 meters away beside the fading orange fire.

The guard slowly looks down toward his spear.

Then toward his shield.

Then back toward the sleeping Cyclops.

His breathing causes subtle natural camera movement.

He quietly whispers:

**"I'm just a normal guard..."**

Natural cave echo.

---

# 4–7 SECONDS — POLYPHEMUS AWAKENS

Still EXACTLY the same first-person POV.

Polyphemus suddenly opens his single eye.

His eye looks directly toward the camera.

The guard freezes.

Polyphemus places one enormous hand onto the cave floor and begins standing.

The guard instinctively tilts his head upward.

The camera follows the giant's rising body naturally.

His shield and trembling spear remain visible in the lower frame.

The guard slowly backs away.

He whispers:

**"I didn't sign up for this."**

Polyphemus begins walking toward the camera.

---

# 7–11.5 SECONDS — THE CHARGE

Still first-person.

No camera switch.

No third-person shot.

Polyphemus suddenly roars and charges directly toward the camera.

The entire cave shakes with his footsteps.

Sheep scatter past the guard.

Clay jars break.

Dust falls from the ceiling.

The guard rapidly backpedals.

His shield bounces in his left hand.

His spear shakes violently in his right hand.

His armored chest and legs move naturally with every step.

He screams:

**"No, no, no—HELP! HELP!"**

The second **HELP** becomes a terrified scream as Polyphemus reaches him.

The Cyclops physically crosses the cave distance.

No teleportation.

No sudden scaling.

No camera perspective change.

---

# 11.5–13 SECONDS — IMPACT

Still the exact same first-person POV.

Polyphemus swings his massive forearm sideways.

The impact knocks the guard backward.

The shield flies from his left hand.

The camera tumbles naturally with his body.

The rocky cave floor rapidly rotates through the frame.

Natural motion blur.

The camera lands tilted on the ground.

The guard's armored torso, wrist and legs are visible in the foreground.

**Never reveal his face.**

---

# 13–15 SECONDS — THE FALLEN GUARD

The camera remains on the cave floor.

Still the same guard.

Still first-person.

His trembling hand enters the frame.

His bronze wrist guard catches the firelight.

His armored torso and sandaled legs remain visible.

Polyphemus crouches above him.

The giant face slowly fills the frame.

His single eye studies the camera.

His enormous hand reaches toward the lens.

The guard quietly whispers:

**"Help..."**

The hand moves toward the camera.

---

# 15–18 SECONDS — THE GRAB

**IMPORTANT: NO CAMERA CUT.**

The giant hand reaches past the camera rather than covering the lens.

Because the camera is still the guard's POV, the audience sees Polyphemus's enormous arm sweep across the frame.

The hand grabs **ONE sailor** from the shadows in the background.

The sailor becomes visible only as another character in front of the guard.

He struggles and cries out.

Polyphemus lifts him from the ground.

The guard remains lying on the cave floor.

His POV does NOT change.

---

# 18–21 SECONDS — ODYSSEUS AND THE SAILORS RUN

Still first-person from the fallen guard.

Odysseus and the **remaining sailors** break from hiding and run toward the cave entrance.

The camera watches them from ground level.

There is no second POV.

There is no third-person shot.

The guard begins struggling to crawl.

His hand reaches toward the ground.

His viewpoint rises slightly as he pushes himself up.

Odysseus and the sailors run past sheep and broken clay vessels.

Polyphemus turns away from the camera while holding the captured sailor.

---

# 21–25 SECONDS — THE GUARD FOLLOWS

The guard manages to stand.

The camera rises with him.

His breathing becomes rapid.

His shield is gone.

His short spear remains in his right hand.

He runs after Odysseus and the sailors.

His hands, spear and armored body bounce naturally in the lower frame.

The cave entrance grows larger ahead.

Cold blue moonlight becomes brighter.

Polyphemus roars behind them.

The camera briefly glances backward.

Polyphemus is visible in the distance.

The camera immediately turns forward again.

**Still exactly the same first-person POV.**

---

# 25–29 SECONDS — ESCAPE

The guard runs out of the cave.

The camera emerges into cool moonlight.

The sea stretches ahead.

The wooden ship is visible near the shore.

Odysseus and the sailors rush toward it.

The guard follows.

His breathing is heavy.

His footsteps splash through shallow seawater.

The camera remains clean and unobstructed.

**No vignette.**

**No lens border.**

**No goggle effect.**

---

# 29–30 SECONDS — FINAL LOOK

The guard reaches the shoreline.

He turns his head back toward the cave.

The camera naturally rotates.

Polyphemus stands enormous inside the cave entrance.

His silhouette is framed by warm firelight against the cool blue night.

His single eye remains visible.

He roars from inside the cave.

The guard watches from the shore.

End on this clean first-person view.

---

# CONTINUITY RULES — ABSOLUTE

1. **ONE GUARD POV FOR THE ENTIRE 30 SECONDS.**
2. **ONE CAMERA PERSPECTIVE FROM BEGINNING TO END.**
3. **ZERO THIRD-PERSON SHOTS.**
4. **ZERO OVER-THE-SHOULDER SHOTS.**
5. **ZERO EXTERNAL SHOTS OF THE GUARD.**
6. **ZERO POV SWITCHES.**
7. **EXACTLY ONE POV GUARD.**
8. Odysseus and the sailors are separate background characters only.

Prompt: 
Use my uploaded portrait/selfie as the ONLY identity and facial reference. Preserve my recognizable facial identity and appearance naturally.

Vertical fashion campaign photograph shot at night with flash: a woman with the face from the reference photo stands frontally on the hull of a rusted abandoned tank in an overgrown field, hands tucked into her trouser pockets, shoulders low, head tipped slightly forward and turned a few degrees off axis, looking toward the lens through dark sunglasses with a completely neutral, expressionless face — all the weight carried by the context rather than the pose. Wardrobe (womenswear): black rectangular wraparound sunglasses with dark opaque lenses; an oversized boxy cream-beige heavyweight t-shirt with dropped shoulders, elbow-length sleeves and a tonal embossed "EXCELLENT" wordmark across the chest; a black paisley-print long-sleeve top layered underneath and showing at the forearms; a heavy silver curb chain necklace; extremely wide-leg olive-and-brown woodland camouflage cargo trousers with large flap side pockets, elasticated cuffs and scattered rhinestone speckling across the legs; a double silver wallet chain looping from the belt loop; and grey suede high-top sneakers with black and white detailing. Hair: jet-black hair with a messy textured fringe falling forward over the brow. Lighting — the entire look of the image: a single frontal flash slightly above the camera axis, medium-diffused. Inverse-square falloff does the work — the subject and the tank sit inside the flash’s range and are fully exposed while the sky and everything beyond drop to absolute black with no information at all; this is a real lighting fall-off, not a black background added afterward. Hard glint sliding across the dark sunglass lenses, defined shadows in the heavy jersey folds, sharp speculars on the silver chains and the rhinestone speckling, no visible cast shadow to either side, and the foreground grass showing the characteristic over-detailed near blades that flash produces. Camera: vertical framing at chest height or slightly below for a mild low angle, the subject centered on the vertical axis occupying the middle third, the rusted hull spreading horizontally behind her as a wide base with the tracks and road wheels running down to the lower edge; her pale cream torso separated from the darker rusted armour by value alone, with no rim light. Depth: planes separated by light falloff rather than focus — everything lit is sharp, everything the flash misses simply disappears. Grade: cool blue-tinted shadows against the warm orange rust of the metal, that temperature opposition being the second visual engine of the image; medium saturation, dense absolute blacks, high contrast, fine mid-ISO grain. Palette: absolute black sky dominating more than half the frame, cream-beige torso as the single luminous block anchoring the eye at chest height, olive and brown camouflage as the earthy central mass rhyming directly with the ochre rust, muted green grass at the base, and silver chains and rhinestones as the metallic accents.

prompts.text:
提示词：

【神明】：
【坐骑 / 神兽】：
【核心法器】：
【人物姿态】：
【主色调】：
【题字】：
【画幅比例】：9:16

生成一幅中国传统工笔重彩神明挂轴，以【神明】作为绝对主视觉，可搭配【坐骑 / 神兽】或一件【核心法器】，人物与核心元素占据画面约 70%–80%。构图强调单神压场，不加入多人群像或复杂大场景，让人物、坐骑与法器形成清晰的大形和视觉动势。

整体追求真正的手工工笔设色感，而不是现代数位国风立绘。人物面容具有古画神像气质，眼白清楚、瞳仁集中、神态威严克制，不做动漫脸、网红脸或游戏角色脸。头发、胡须、神兽毛发以成束、连续、顺着体积生长的毛笔长线塑形，线条有自然提按、粗细变化和收锋，清楚但不生硬。

勾线不要使用纯黑、极细、极锐的漫画描边。人物主轮廓使用墨褐、青墨褐、暖灰墨；面部与手部使用淡赭墨；衣纹、毛发与云气逐级减轻线权。线条用于托住颜色，而不是压住色面，让画面先呈现完整设色，再看到细腻笔线。

色彩采用低饱和但饱满、均匀的传统矿物重彩，以【主色调】为核心，可搭配石青、石绿、朱砂、赭红、旧金、象牙白、墨灰等颜色。设色呈现淡色打底、分染、罩染、积色的层次感，同一区域主色稳定完整，不使用数字平涂、高反差硬色块或随机斑驳纹理。

服饰、甲胄、冠饰和法器细节丰富但克制：先建立完整结构，再加入少量云纹、回纹、莲纹、鳞纹等传统纹样。不要在所有甲片、衣袍和饰件内部堆满微型花纹。复杂感来自结构层级，而不是碎纹数量。

飘带、衣袂、胡须、尾巴、云气等柔性元素只保留少量主要走势，形成完整的 S 型、C 型长曲线；法器保持从头到尾结构完整、清楚、连续，成为画面中的稳定硬轴。

背景使用干净温润、偏中性的暖象牙色熟宣纸，只保留极轻天然纸纤维、少量淡青灰云气和充分留白。不要越画越黄，不要奶黄、土黄、棕黄旧照片滤镜，也不要惨白背景。古意来自笔、色、纸、字，而不是脏旧、裂纹、褪色和颗粒。

画面加入完整古画题跋系统：使用【题字】作为主标题，搭配较小副题、少量竖排题跋及 3–5 枚大小错落的朱红印章。书法具有自然毛笔提按，不做现代海报式巨大 Typography。

整体效果像真正由画师在熟宣纸上以毛笔勾线、矿物颜料层层敷染完成的工笔重彩神明画：大形稳定、人物突出、毛发柔顺、线条温润、颜色饱满、纸面干净，古雅但不褪色，精细但不数字化。

避免：多人群像、复杂场景、纯黑硬描边、极细漫画线、矢量轮廓线、自动平滑线、数字平涂、密集短毛、随机金粉点、微碎纹理、斑驳褪色、人工做旧、过黄纸张、动漫脸、仙侠立绘、游戏概念图、CG高光、塑料金属、发光法器、满屏特效。

PEACE SIGN.

【主题】：填写展览主题

设计一张「东方暗黑档案」实验博物馆海报。

使用泛黄旧纸、宣纸纤维、扫描颗粒、墨迹渗透和自然印刷磨损作为背景质感，以大面积墨黑平面结构制造强烈正负形关系。黑色必须参与构图，可使用斜切、巨大圆弧、纵向断层、夜幕负空间等形式，每个主题使用不同结构，避免简单套版。

将【核心图像】处理成残缺古图或文物档案切片，只展示最有辨识度的局部，例如眼睛、面具半脸、甲胄与兵刃、星盘与星图等。保留裂纹、褪色颜料、锈蚀、木纹、拓印或年代磨损，让画面像重新发现的古代视觉档案，而不是普通国风插画。

中文主标题使用巨大粗粝书法、碑刻或拓印感字体；英文标题使用超大高对比衬线字体，可裁切、越界、被黑色结构遮挡。副标题、主题短句、TIME、ADDRESS 集中在安静区域，层级清楚，并加入一枚极小朱砂红印章。

整体低饱和，以墨黑、旧纸米黄、赭石、暗金、灰绿为主。画面保持神秘、古老、克制、具有博物馆实验海报与文化档案感。

避免：普通国风模板、完整主体立绘、素材堆砌、玄幻游戏感、旅游宣传感、高饱和色彩、发光特效、密集小字、乱码、Logo、水印、图片编号。

Seedance 2.5 Prompt
Create a 15-second, 16:9 photorealistic cyberpunk dance music video with dynamic action-film cinematography.

Use SIX DISTINCT SHOTS with deliberate cuts, dramatic changes in camera height, strong foreground perspective, fast physical camera movement, and clear visual continuity. The performer dances continuously through the edits.

REFERENCE DIRECTION

Use the supplied character sheet for exact character identity. It shows multiple views of ONE adult female cyborg.

Preserve her white perforated head plate, black respirator, curved spiked black head tubes, long white hair-like strands, glossy black full-body suit, detailed mechanical armor, articulated metal fingers, hanging rings, layered waist fabric, heavy platform boots, and mechanical backpack. Her face remains concealed.

Use the supplied dance video as the reference for the industrial cyberpunk setting, dance style, lighting, atmosphere, digital noise, and glitch treatment. Follow the NEW camera sequence below.

ENVIRONMENT AND PERFORMANCE

The same immense underground industrial rave chamber: dark steel architecture, elevated walkways, exposed pipes, suspended red neon rings, cold cyan highlights, reflective flooring, and drifting ground fog.

Preserve the expanding red light-ring spectacle behind the performer during the climax.

Her choreography combines sharp shoulder hits, chest pops, angular arm movements, grounded heel-toe steps, and controlled pivots. Maintain convincing weight, foot contact, and rhythmic continuity. Her white strands, hanging fabric, and heavy head tubes react naturally to acceleration.

CAMERA SEQUENCE — SIX SHOTS

SHOT 1 — 0.0–1.5 seconds
EXTREME CLOSE-UP / IMMEDIATE IMPACT.
Begin close to the white mask from slightly below eye level. The performer is already moving on the first frame. She snaps her head toward the lens while one mechanical hand sweeps across the foreground, passing close to the camera.

The camera makes a short, sharp backward movement as the hand approaches. Use the hand briefly covering the frame as a motivated cut into the next shot.

SHOT 2 — 1.5–4.0 seconds
GROUND-LEVEL WIDE / AGGRESSIVE BACKWARD TRACKING.

Hard cut to a camera just above the reflective floor with a 24mm wide-angle perspective. A heavy boot lands in the foreground on the beat.
Track backward rapidly as she advances through two powerful dance steps, revealing her complete silhouette from a commanding low angle. Red rings and steel columns shift visibly through the background, creating strong parallax. Add one brief, controlled camera impact at the foot strike, then recover immediately.

SHOT 3 — 4.0–5.5 seconds
TIGHT THREE-QUARTER CLOSE-UP / FOREGROUND HAND MOVEMENT.

Cut to a tight view of her mask, shoulders, and articulated hands from the front-right side. Use a slight Dutch angle.

Track her angular hand movement as her fingers pass close to the lens. Keep the mask readable behind the foreground hand. End with a fast lateral whip-pan following the arm sweep; cut within the directional motion blur.
SHOT 4 — 5.5–8.5 seconds
LOW SIDE ANGLE / FAST 90-DEGREE ORBIT.

Cut to a full-body side view and execute one decisive 90-degree camera arc toward her front while she performs a grounded pivot and sharp shoulder accents.

Keep a consistent distance from the performer during the orbit. Nearby structural elements sweep through the foreground while distant neon rings move more slowly, producing substantial depth and speed. Her white strands and ribbed tubes trail behind the turn with believable inertia.

Complete the arc cleanly and let the final dance hit register.
SHOT 5 — 8.5–10.5 seconds
DIRECTLY OVERHEAD / GEOMETRIC DANCE COMPOSITION.

Hard cut to a true top-down view. Her full body is visible inside concentric red floor-light patterns.

She performs a tight pivot and opens her arms into a precise geometric pose. The camera descends slightly while maintaining its vertical view. Floor reflections, moving fabric, and circular light pulses form a clear graphic composition.

SHOT 6 — 10.5–15.0 seconds
LOW-ANGLE HERO SHOT / CLIMACTIC RUSH-IN.

Cut to a low frontal wide shot as the enormous red light rings expand behind her. She delivers the strongest sequence of the dance: a chest hit, an arm sweep, and a heavy planted step.
The camera initially tracks sideways slightly, revealing the depth between her silhouette and the illuminated rings.

At approximately 13 seconds, accelerate into a fast physical dolly toward her mask. The environment rushes past with strong perspective change. Decelerate smoothly into an intense mask close-up for the final half-second, matching the opening angle and framing for a visual loop.

GLITCH, NOISE, AND EDITING

Preserve the reference video's cyberpunk noise and glitch aesthetic. Synchronize horizontal image tearing, chromatic separation, scanline interference, and digital grit with strong musical accents and selected cut points.
Keep the character's physical anatomy consistent beneath the effects. Maintain clear motion direction across cuts. Each camera position must be visibly distinct.

Use hard cuts, foreground wipes, and one motivated whip-pan transition. Show actual perspective and parallax changes during camera travel. Keep dance movements readable between the fastest camera accents.

SOUND DIRECTION

Heavy industrial techno, distorted bass, metallic percussion, electrical textures, and synchronized boot impacts. Maintain the reference video's musical energy. No dialogue or vocals.

CONSTRAINTS

One performer. Consistent character design and room geometry. No additional limbs, character duplication, costume changes, floating feet, or camera movement through solid objects.

No prolonged static frontal coverage, endless camera spinning, morphing between shots, or excessive motion blur hiding the choreography.

Dance performance throughout. No combat, weapons, subtitles, logos, watermarks, or character-sheet text.

The view from the top of the tank.

Prompt: 
Use my uploaded portrait/selfie as the ONLY identity and facial reference. Preserve my recognizable facial identity and appearance naturally.

Vertical fashion campaign photograph shot at night with flash: a woman with the face from the reference photo stands frontally on the hull of a rusted abandoned tank in an overgrown field, hands tucked into her trouser pockets, shoulders low, head tipped slightly forward and turned a few degrees off axis, looking toward the lens through dark sunglasses with a completely neutral, expressionless face — all the weight carried by the context rather than the pose. Wardrobe (womenswear): black rectangular wraparound sunglasses with dark opaque lenses; an oversized boxy cream-beige heavyweight t-shirt with dropped shoulders, elbow-length sleeves and a tonal embossed "EXCELLENT" wordmark across the chest; a black paisley-print long-sleeve top layered underneath and showing at the forearms; a heavy silver curb chain necklace; extremely wide-leg olive-and-brown woodland camouflage cargo trousers with large flap side pockets, elasticated cuffs and scattered rhinestone speckling across the legs; a double silver wallet chain looping from the belt loop; and grey suede high-top sneakers with black and white detailing. Hair: jet-black hair with a messy textured fringe falling forward over the brow. Lighting — the entire look of the image: a single frontal flash slightly above the camera axis, medium-diffused. Inverse-square falloff does the work — the subject and the tank sit inside the flash’s range and are fully exposed while the sky and everything beyond drop to absolute black with no information at all; this is a real lighting fall-off, not a black background added afterward. Hard glint sliding across the dark sunglass lenses, defined shadows in the heavy jersey folds, sharp speculars on the silver chains and the rhinestone speckling, no visible cast shadow to either side, and the foreground grass showing the characteristic over-detailed near blades that flash produces. Camera: vertical framing at chest height or slightly below for a mild low angle, the subject centered on the vertical axis occupying the middle third, the rusted hull spreading horizontally behind her as a wide base with the tracks and road wheels running down to the lower edge; her pale cream torso separated from the darker rusted armour by value alone, with no rim light. Depth: planes separated by light falloff rather than focus — everything lit is sharp, everything the flash misses simply disappears. Grade: cool blue-tinted shadows against the warm orange rust of the metal, that temperature opposition being the second visual engine of the image; medium saturation, dense absolute blacks, high contrast, fine mid-ISO grain. Palette: absolute black sky dominating more than half the frame, cream-beige torso as the single luminous block anchoring the eye at chest height, olive and brown camouflage as the earthy central mass rhyming directly with the ochre rust, muted green grass at the base, and silver chains and rhinestones as the metallic accents.
